basalDose: 50% N + 100% P2O5 + 100% K2O at final puddling/transplanting
topDressing: 25% N at active tillering (3 weeks) + 25% N at panicle initiation (6 weeks)

basalDose: 50% N + 100% P2O5 + 100% K2O drilled at sowing
topDressing: 25% N at Crown Root Initiation (CRI - 21 DAS) + 25% N at first node/flowering stage
33% N at knee-high stage (30 DAS) + 34% N at tasseling stage (50 DAS)

basalDose: 100% N + 100% P2O5 + 100% K2O as basal starter dose (incorporate Rhizobium seed inoculant)
topDressing: Foliar spray of 2% Urea at flowering if nodulation is suboptimal

basalDose: 100% N + 100% P2O5 + 100% K2O with 20 kg/ha Sulphur at sowing
topDressing: Rhizobium and PSB seed treatment; foliar DAP 2% at pod formation

basalDose: 100% N + 100% P2O5 + 100% K2O + 200 kg/ha Gypsum at sowing
topDressing: 200 kg/ha Gypsum at pegging stage (40-45 DAS) for pod filling and calcium supply

basalDose: 100% N + 100% P2O5 + 100% K2O with 20 kg/ha Sulphur at sowing
topDressing: Bradyrhizobium japonicum inoculation; no top dressing needed if nodulated

basalDose: 50% N + 100% P2O5 + 100% K2O + 20 kg/ha elemental Sulphur at sowing

topDressing: 40% N at square formation + 40% N + 50% K2O at peak boll development

basalDose: 30% N + 100% P2O5 + 50% K2O in furrows before planting setts
topDressing: 35% N at tillering (45-60 DAP) + 35% N + 50% K2O at formative stage (90-120 DAP)
